_comment: Paths a desktop build is ALLOWED to add or modify in the tracked/untracked-not-ignored tree. Empty by policy: build outputs (dist/, out/, resources/build-info.json, resources/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) are gitignored, and the root THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md must already be committed for the current lockfile (the workflow fails closed on drift). Any addition here is a reviewed policy change.
